memory_candidates: enriched_bypass_formula_depth1 is unsound: depth0_3var_exist_formula encodes only y-x order (Since/Until relative to x) and y-predicates, but NOT y-t order. Two ssn values differing only in y-t order produce identical temporal formulas, causing phi AND neg-phi contradictions in quant_profile_conj_depth0 when sub_nf.2 assigns different values.

Temporal formulas evaluated at position x fundamentally cannot express y-t order because they reference points relative to x, not relative to a third point t. This applies to both simple (Since/Until) and nested temporal formulas.

The enriched formula bypass approach does NOT avoid the Feferman-Vaught composition requirement at nf_exist_backward_prior (NfCharFormula.lean:541). Both require proving that on Prior structures, knowing x's depth-(k+1) 1-var NF + t's predicates + x-t order determines the 3-var quantifier profile.
